doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: «Затишок» Range: 0-100 (starts at 60 on early levels), Decreases over time (decay rate), Increases when events are resolved successfully, Decreases when events expire or fail. Event Types & Scoring: Minor Events: «Затишок» on resolve: +5, «Затишок» on failure: -5. Standard Events: «Затишок» on resolve: +8, «Затишок» on failure: -10. Critical Events: «Затишок» on resolve: +10, «Затишок» on failure: -20.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR7: The game tracks and displays the «Затишок» meter (0-100) which decreases over time and changes based on event outcomes. The «Затишок» meter is a core resource that players must manage during the evening. It decreases over time (decay rate) and changes based on event outcomes (rewards for resolved events, penalties for expired events).

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR10: The game ends the evening when either the timer reaches 0 (win) or «Затишок» reaches 0 (lose). Lose condition: When «Затишок» reaches 0 before timer ends, the game ends with lose state, results screen is shown, partial rewards are calculated (if player made progress).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Game Loop: Uses requestAnimationFrame for 60 FPS gameplay. Updates game state every frame using delta time for frame-rate independence. Game loop updates coziness every frame using delta time. Coziness decay calculation: coziness -= COZINESS_DECAY_RATE * deltaTime. Follow architecture document "Game Loop" section for frame-rate independent updates.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Data Architecture: GameState interface includes coziness property (number, 0-100 range). GameState.coziness is a number (0-100 range). GameContext provides coziness state and setCoziness update function. Coziness value stored in GameState interface.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story 2.10 focuses on implementing the «Затишок» meter system. The meter decreases over time (decay rate) and changes based on event outcomes. Resolved events increase coziness by event's coziness reward. Expired events decrease coziness by event's coziness penalty. Coziness is clamped between 0 and 100. If coziness reaches 0, game ends (lose condition). Starting coziness is affected by level bonuses (Story 3.3). Coziness updates are integrated with game loop (updates every frame, frame-rate independent).

doc.title: Story 2.9: Event Interaction System
doc.snippet: Event interaction system fully implemented. Event resolution already updates coziness: setCoziness(prev => prev + resolvedEvent.cozinessReward). Event resolution data includes cozinessReward value. Integration point: coziness updates on event resolution are already working. No changes needed to event interaction system for this story. GameContext provides coziness state and update functions. Use functional updates: setCoziness(prev => prev + value) to avoid stale closures.

doc.title: Story 2.1: Game State Management and Game Loop
doc.snippet: Game loop hook implemented. useGameLoop hook wraps requestAnimationFrame. Game loop updates every frame (~60 FPS). Delta time calculation available for frame-rate independent updates. Game loop integrates with GameContext for state updates. Add coziness decay calculation to game loop update function. GameState interface includes coziness property. GameState.coziness: number (0-100 range). Initial game state sets coziness to COZINESS_START.

artifact.reason: Main game loop hook that updates game state every frame. Already implements coziness decay calculation in game loop (lines 134-146). Uses delta time for frame-rate independent updates. Updates coziness every frame: const cozinessDecay = COZINESS_DECAY_RATE * deltaTime; const newCoziness = Math.max(0, currentState.coziness - cozinessDecay); setCozinessRef.current(newCoziness); Already handles expired events and applies coziness penalties (lines 195-206). Need to ensure lose condition check is implemented when coziness reaches 0 (currently has comment for Story 2.11).

constraint.description: Game loop already implements coziness decay calculation using delta time (frame-rate independent). GameContext provides setCoziness function that automatically clamps coziness to 0-100 range. Event resolution already updates coziness (from Story 2.9). Follow architecture document "Game Loop" and "Data Architecture" sections.

Coziness decay is already implemented in game loop (useGameLoop.ts lines 134-146). Decay calculation: const cozinessDecay = COZINESS_DECAY_RATE * deltaTime; const newCoziness = Math.max(0, currentState.coziness - cozinessDecay); Decay is frame-rate independent (uses delta time, not fixed per frame). Decay rate constant: COZINESS_DECAY_RATE = 0.5 per second (from constants.ts). Decay rate will be modified by level bonuses in Story 3.3. Current implementation already handles decay correctly.

Event resolution coziness updates are already working (from Story 2.9). Event interaction system updates coziness: setCoziness(prev => prev + resolvedEvent.cozinessReward). Event resolution data includes cozinessReward value from EVENT_COZINESS_IMPACT constant. No changes needed to event interaction system for this story. Integration point: coziness updates on event resolution are already working.

Event expiration coziness updates are already implemented in game loop (useGameLoop.ts lines 195-206). Expired events are processed: expiredEvents.forEach((event) => { const newCoziness = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, currentCoziness + event.cozinessPenalty)); setCozinessRef.current(newCoziness); }); Event expiration already applies coziness penalties correctly. EventManager.updateEvents() returns expired events. Expired events have cozinessPenalty value from EVENT_COZINESS_IMPACT constant.

Coziness clamping is already implemented in GameContext.setCoziness() function (lines 123-127). Automatically clamps to 0-100 range: const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value)); Clamping is applied in setCoziness function and updateGameState function. No additional clamping needed in game loop or event handlers. Clamping ensures coziness never goes below 0 or above 100.

Lose condition check needs to be implemented when coziness reaches 0. Game loop already checks if coziness reaches 0 (line 142), but only has comment for Story 2.11. Need to implement: if (newCoziness === 0) { setGameOver(true); setPlaying(false); } Lose condition should stop game loop when coziness reaches 0. Win condition will be implemented in Story 2.11 (timer reaches 0). Reference GameContext for game state flags (setGameOver, setPlaying).

Starting coziness uses COZINESS_START constant (60). initializeGameState() function sets initial coziness to COZINESS_START (useGameLoop.ts line 315). Starting coziness will be modified by level bonuses in Story 3.3. Current implementation already uses COZINESS_START constant correctly. No changes needed for this story.

Coziness updates are already integrated with game loop. Game loop updates coziness every frame using delta time (frame-rate independent). Coziness decay is calculated in game loop (lines 134-146). Event expiration coziness penalties are applied in game loop (lines 195-206). Coziness updates are synchronized with game loop. Game loop stops when game is paused or over (lines 121, 218). Need to ensure lose condition stops game loop when coziness reaches 0.

Coziness value is accessible from GameContext (gameState.coziness). Coziness value format: number (0-100 range). HUD display will be implemented in Story 2.14 (CozinessBar component). This story ensures coziness value is properly maintained and accessible for HUD display. No changes needed to prepare for HUD display - coziness value is already accessible from GameContext.
